snippet.title: RIP ME! – Announcement Trailer | Pack Opening Incremental | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
RIP ME! is a pixel-art booster pack incremental. Rip packs, pull shiny hits, clean and grade your best cards, then show them off in your display case. Build a Rip Bot, chase God Packs and misprints across an ever-growing lineup of series, and hunt the legendary Grails.

Out 2 December 2026 on Steam. Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5458160

More Room Games on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RoomGames
